presentation.title_rationale: The reader problem is deciding which Copilot usage numbers can be trusted and how to get team totals the API omits. The selected 59-character title frontloads the product and names exactly the three things the body delivers - accuracy caveats, coverage gaps and the documented team-report join - without promising a benchmark, ranking or fix.
